ViGALT_ablation.alt_text: A light-gray sweater body has repeating vertical zigzag bands filled with small diamond texture. Brown contrast panels run along the outer lower sleeves, which end in ribbed knit cuffs, and a ribbed knit hem runs along the bottom edge. A short front placket opens from the collar and has a dark button near the upper chest.
